title: Protocol for Stable Cell Line Production to Express Muscle-Type Nicotinic Receptor
author: Li, Sauer, et al.
materials: Expi293F cells (Gibco) were purchased from Thermo Fisher Scientific for this study. Cells were maintained in Freestyle 293 medium supplemented with 0.1% v/v penicillin-streptomycin-amphotericin B mix (PSA, Lonza) or 0.1% v/v penicillin-streptomycin (PS, Invitrogen or Merck). During the prolonged incubation time in the early stages of clonal expansion, a higher concentration of 1% v/v PSA was added to prevent contamination. This will be referred to as growth medium. All buffers and reagents should be prepared in advance and sterilized using a 0.22 μm filter.

steps.title: Prepare growth medium
steps.instruction: Make Freestyle 293 medium and supplement with either 0.1 % v/v penicillin‑streptomycin‑amphotericin B mix (PSA, Lonza) or 0.1 % v/v penicillin‑streptomycin (PS, Invitrogen or Merck); for early clonal expansion add 1 % v/v PSA. Filter‑sterilize all buffers and reagents through a 0.22 µm filter.

steps.title: Sterilize work area and items
steps.instruction: Clean the biosafety‑level‑2 tissue‑culture hood and all equipment with 70 % ethanol before entry; wipe the exterior of pre‑sterilized packaging and any tubes that will be removed from the hood; ensure all glassware and plasticware are sterilized.

steps.title: Maintain Expi293F cells
steps.instruction: Culture Expi293F cells (Gibco, Thermo Fisher) in the prepared growth medium. For adherent cultures keep at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ in a humidified stationary incubator. For suspension cultures keep at 37 °C, 8 % CO₂, 75 % humidity, shaking at 100–250 rpm in an Infors HT Multitron shaker (25 mm throw). Adjust shaking speed to vessel type: 24‑well blocks (VWR) at 250 rpm; 100–500 mL vented Erlenmeyer flasks (Corning or Jet Biofil) at 100–150 rpm; roller bottles (Greiner Bio‑One) at 150–180 rpm, increasing speed with larger volumes. Maintain cell density between 0.3 × 10⁶ and 3 × 10⁶ cells mL⁻¹.

steps.title: Seed cells for expression
steps.instruction: Seed cells at 1 × 10⁶ cells mL⁻¹ for protein expression. The following day add doxycycline to induce expression of the muscle‑type nicotinic receptor.

steps.title: Expand clonal cultures
steps.instruction: During prolonged clonal expansion use the higher PSA concentration (1 % v/v) to prevent contamination. Perform repeated passaging while keeping the culture density within 0.3–3 × 10⁶ cells mL⁻¹.

steps.title: Assess AChR surface expression
steps.instruction: Perform a 125I‑α‑bungarotoxin binding assay on each clone. Typical labeling gives ~10 000 cpm for ~1.2 × 10⁶ cells (confluent 6‑well). Identify clones with >20 000 cpm (≥2‑fold over background) as high‑expressing. Record that out of 32 clones three exceeded this threshold; the clone ‘4_1 B6’ showed sustained expression for >4 months and was chosen for scale‑up.

steps.title: Scale‑up selected clone
steps.instruction: Expand the chosen ‘4_1 B6’ clone in large‑volume suspension culture under the same growth conditions. Harvest cells when appropriate density is reached for protein production.

steps.title: Prepare membranes and solubilize
steps.instruction: Isolate cell membranes from harvested culture. Solubilize membranes with n‑dodecyl‑β‑D‑maltoside detergent supplemented with cholesteryl hemisuccinate.

steps.title: Purify AChR and assess quality
steps.instruction: Carry out affinity purification of the solubilized receptor, then run size‑exclusion chromatography (SEC). Verify monodispersity on SEC, confirm presence of all four subunits by tryptic‑digest mass spectrometry, and test proper folding by co‑elution of an anti‑AChR‑α Fab fragment and α‑bungarotoxin. Expected yield is ~6 µg AChR per liter of culture.
